data.name: Path and Hard Surface Cleaning Melbourne | Prime Exteriors
data.description: Cleaning the hard surfaces nobody quotes: footpaths, crossovers, side access, bin areas, steps, service yards and letterbox surrounds across Melbourne. Cheap as part of a visit, and usually the worst surfaces on a property.

mainEntity.name: Can you clean the council footpath out the front?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, and it is worth doing. A clean driveway running into a dark council footpath looks worse than leaving both, and the strip in front of a property is read as part of it by anyone looking at the house.

Adding it while the gear is already out costs very little, and it finishes the frontage rather than leaving a line across it.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth cleaning the side access nobody sees?

acceptedAnswer.text:
For appearance, probably not. For safety, usually yes. The side access is normally the dampest, shadiest and most slippery hard surface on a property and it is where the bins get wheeled in the dark.

It is also cheap as part of a visit, which is the real argument.

mainEntity.name: How much extra is it to add paths to a driveway clean?

acceptedAnswer.text:
A fraction of what the same square metres cost on their own, because getting water, power, access and gear onto a site is most of the overhead on a small job. Once that is paid for, more surface is inexpensive.

It is the single best value decision available when booking exterior work.

mainEntity.name: Will cleaning the bin area get rid of the smell?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Usually, because the smell is normally in the concrete rather than in the bin. Spillage soaks into a porous pad and stays there, and rinsing it with a hose does not reach it.

Treating and cleaning the pad deals with it. Sealing it afterwards means the next spill sits on the surface instead.

Yes, and steps are detailed by hand rather than machined, because the tread, the riser and the nosing all need different attention and a rotary head cannot reach them.

Where steps stay permanently damp, anti slip sealing is worth more on them than on anything else, because the consequence of slipping is highest there.
